title: Mandris, a 3d third person space shooter
author: Kooba2
selftext:
Mandris is a 3d space shooter that runs in the browser (for now). I'm looking for feedback as the game is very much in the early stages of development.

I'm aware the mobile version of the game is very unrefined, it's probably not really playable on mobile yet and I may cut that entirely.

**History**

About three weeks ago I woke up one day and wanted to build a 2D shooter inspired by the old game Raptor: Call of the shadows. Once I built the original game I decided to see what I could do to improve the graphics so I started messing with Blender and Astra. It created what I thought was a pretty decent looking 3D game. Then Opus 5.5 came out and I started redoing a lot of the art with Opus 5.5 and was absolutely blown away at what it could do.

**Tech Stack**  
The tech stack is just vite/three.js/blender. I also use Elevanlabs for generating sound/music. As I mentioned above, I used the AI models  Astra and Opus 5.5 for the engine and assets of the game.

**Links**

You can play the game here:

[https://mandris.app](https://mandris.app/)
